translation: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion
And the earth throws up her burdens (from within)
And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her
On that Day will she declare her tidings
For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration

arabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
translation: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done)

arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
translation: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it

arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
translation: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it
